variants.prompt: The French beauty exudes raw, sensual power as she leans against a weathered wooden dock railing at sunset. A black leather corset hugs her waist and enhances her ample bust, while a flowing, sheer skirt dances in the ocean breeze. Emerald eyes blaze with intensity as she turns to face the camera, her full lips curled into a bold, commanding smile. Tousled honey-blonde hair frames her face, and strappy black heels add a touch of edginess to her overall look. The camera frames her in a dramatic overhead shot, looking down on her from above.
